title: Zesty Glazed German Pork Casserole
description: A light German dish featuring sweet sherry and a zesty glaze, this casserole is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is also ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly, making it a great option for those looking for a balancing meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sweet sherry, honey, Dijon mustard, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to make the glaze.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and onions.
In a separate bowl, rub the pork shoulder with a little bit of the glaze, making sure to coat it evenly.
In a large casserole dish, create a layer of potatoes and onions, followed by a layer of the glazed pork shoulder.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients have been used, finishing with a layer of potatoes and onions on top.
Brush the remaining glaze over the top layer of potatoes and onions.
Cover the casserole dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
